# NXT Foundry

> Boutique management consulting and technology practice based in Bengaluru, India, for owner-led and mid-market businesses. Works on operations and business performance, revenue and financial control, procurement and supply chain, and inventory and margin, with expertise in internal controls (SOX 404 / ICoFR, ITGC), internal audit, risk analytics and process automation. Senior-led, with Big 4 risk advisory experience: the people clients meet are the people who do the work.

## Services
- [Advisory & Diagnostics](https://www.nxtfoundry.in/#solutions): Short diagnostic engagements that identify operational and control weaknesses, and ongoing senior advisory
- [Managed Solutions & Execution](https://www.nxtfoundry.in/#solutions): Hands-on implementation of fixes alongside client teams
- [Technology & Automation](https://www.nxtfoundry.in/#products): Workflow automation, BI and business apps, including reconciliation tools

## Stories
Case stories and concept frameworks. Concepts are independently developed and their figures are illustrative.
- [A PO lifecycle dashboard for unmapped purchase orders and invoice exceptions](https://www.nxtfoundry.in/#stories/automotive-po-invoice-lifecycle): Automotive · Concept. We designed a Power BI dashboard concept that tracks every PO from approval to payment and surfaces the exceptions.
- [Closing ₹5 crore of revenue leakage in a fitness chain’s access controls](https://www.nxtfoundry.in/#stories/fitness-access-controls): Fitness & wellness · Consulting project · earlier work. We limited each membership to one device and one sign-in method, and put gate barriers under monitoring.
- [Bringing accountability to a ₹76 crore warehouse reconciliation gap](https://www.nxtfoundry.in/#stories/warehouse-stock-transfers): E-commerce · Tech implementation · earlier work. We helped build a reconciliation tool with advance notice, a four-hour window and automatic escalation.
- [Breaking the cycle of slow and non-moving inventory in B2B wholesale](https://www.nxtfoundry.in/#stories/wholesale-slow-moving-inventory): E-commerce · Consulting project · earlier work. We reworked how demand, buying and stock connect — from forecasting and PO controls to redistribution between regions.
- [Automating 94 payroll checks for apparel manufacturers](https://www.nxtfoundry.in/#stories/payroll-compliance-framework): Apparel manufacturing · Concept. We built a conceptual Power BI framework that automates 94 payroll validation and audit checks across eight control areas.
- [Choosing where to build: a what-if framework for 17 cities](https://www.nxtfoundry.in/#stories/global-location-strategy): Banking & financial services · Concept. We built a conceptual Power BI framework that scores 17 cities on one 0–10 scale and lets leaders test trade-offs live.
- [Spotting counterfeit risk on a marketplace before customers do](https://www.nxtfoundry.in/#stories/marketplace-anti-counterfeit): E-commerce · Concept. We designed a conceptual framework that scores listings and sellers on many signals and routes the riskiest to investigation.
